scope: Compact export of recorded measurements; detailed arrays removed, not a new experiment.

measurement.dataset: CSE-CIC-IDS2018 official processed daily flow CSVs

protocol.scope: temporal drift/adaptation only; no AutoML optimization on CSE
protocol.target: binary: Benign vs any non-Benign label
protocol.model: LightGBM 100 estimators, learning_rate=0.05, num_leaves=31, CPU n_jobs=1
protocol.adaptation_window: initial labeled training sample plus most recent 3 labeled replay chunks
limitations: Daily CSV source order is not chronological; timestamps are parsed day-first and sorted before replay.
This is a binary attack/benign replay over a CIC testbed schedule, not a production network stream.
Label-based error detection assumes labels arrive at chunk end and is not an unlabeled early-warning detector.

run_audit.experiment_variant: 40,000-row target replay chunks; seed 42; all other configured trigger/window policies held by chunk count.
run_audit.project_workload: No other project experiment ran concurrently.
run_audit.sensitivity_interpretation: The larger batch changes confirmation delay, periodic update spacing, number of calibration chunks, and rows in the recent-label window; it is an operational chunk-design sensitivity, not an isolated batch-only treatment.
